speaker: COMMANDER
text: ...Stars. Why am I looking at stars?

speaker: COMMANDER
text: I'm outside. I'm outside the ship.

speaker: SHIP AI
text: Commander. A rock struck us as we left the ring. The hatch failed and you were pulled out.

speaker: SHIP AI
text: Your suit has no thrusters. You have four minutes of air.

speaker: COMMANDER
text: No thrusters. Nothing to push against.

speaker: ENGINEER
text: Stuck in zero gravity, that ball is the difference between drifting forever and getting home.

speaker: COMMANDER
text: I promised I'd come back. So move.

speaker: COMMANDER
text: Keep the lights on. I'm not done yet.

speaker: SHIP AI
text: The hatch is sealed from the strike. The emergency release is the yellow box beside it. Hit it.

speaker: SHIP AI
text: Release fired. The hatch is open. Come home.

speaker: SHIP AI
text: That is glazed with frost. The ball cannot bite into it. It will only skip off. Look for bare rock or torn hull.

speaker: SHIP AI
text: Debris is wedged against the hatch. It is loose. Knock it clear with the ball.

speaker: SHIP AI
text: Debris is clear. Now the emergency release. The yellow box beside the hatch.

speaker: SHIP AI
text: Hatch is clear. Come home.

speaker: SHIP AI
text: It's holding. Now reel yourself in.

speaker: SHIP AI
text: Good. Now the next one. Work your way to the hull.

speaker: COMMANDER
text: Got it. I've got the rail.

speaker: SHIP AI
text: Outer hatch cycling. Welcome back, Commander.

speaker: SHIP AI
text: Proximity alert. Object on a collision course.

speaker: COMMANDER
text: I see it. Brace—

speaker: SHIP AI
text: Commander? Commander, respond.

speaker: SHIP AI
text: Hatch sealed. Cabin pressure is holding.

speaker: SHIP AI
text: Commander, the strike took out main power. Life support is running on reserve.

speaker: COMMANDER
text: One problem at a time. Where are we? Where's Mission Control?

speaker: SHIP AI
text: Unknown. Unknown. And I would like to also say unknown.

speaker: SHIP AI
text: You're overclocking the power bus? That is not in the manual. ...It's working.

speaker: COMMANDER
text: Blue oceans. Clouds. That's... that's home. Somehow I'm home.

speaker: SHIP AI
text: Overlaying Earth's continents now.

speaker: SHIP AI
text: They don't match. There is no Moon, only that small burnt one. The stars are wrong.

speaker: SHIP AI
text: Commander, I regret to inform you that this is not Earth. I also regret to inform you that I don't know where we are.

speaker: SHIP AI
text: Our orbit is decaying. Would you like our survival odds, or a comforting lie?

speaker: SHIP AI
text: Thirty-one percent. I rounded up.

speaker: SHIP AI
text: Everything is fine. We will definitely be fine. This is a normal Tuesday.

speaker: COMMANDER
text: ...Thanks.

speaker: SHIP AI
text: Rerouting all priorities to 'down'.

speaker: SHIP AI
text: Engines online. Beginning atmospheric entry. Please hold on to something. Anything.

speaker: SHIP AI
text: Every gate and every harvester reports to this place. It has run for thousands of years with nobody here.

speaker: SHIP AI
text: Commander, the star charts here match the first planet. It was never a second Earth. It was the builders' homeworld.

speaker: COMMANDER
text: They drained it, left it, and it healed without them.

speaker: SHIP AI
text: The console is live. From here you can shut the harvesters down, turn them on other worlds, or lock the gates to one world.

speaker: COMMANDER
text: The builders had this same choice. They chose to keep taking.

speaker: COLONY PILOT
text: We shut them down. Both our worlds, together. That's the only version where nobody becomes them.

speaker: COLONY PILOT
text: I don't know what you'll choose. I know what my people would be afraid of.

speaker: COLONY PILOT
text: After everything? I trusted you.

speaker: COLONY PILOT
text: I knew it. Earth first. It was always going to be Earth first.

speaker: COLONY PILOT
text: You're just going to leave them? All of them?

speaker: COLONY PILOT
text: I read the transmission logs while you were at the console. You knew, and you said nothing.

speaker: COLONY PILOT
text: Share the network with Earth? I can't even share the truth with you.

speaker: COLONY PILOT
text: Together, then. On three.

speaker: COMMANDER
text: You don't have to trust Earth. Trust what we both saw out there. Neither of our worlds survives this alone.

speaker: COLONY PILOT
text: ...That's the first thing an Earther has said that my people would believe. On three.

speaker: COLONY PILOT
text: Hand the gates to both worlds? I barely trust you. I'm not turning that key.

speaker: SHIP AI
text: No atmosphere. Your suit is all you have. You can refill at the ship.

speaker: COLONY PILOT
text: Old machines everywhere. Someone mined this place hollow, long before us.

speaker: SHIP AI
text: The refinery needs coolant, run from the coldest tank to the hottest. Get it wrong and it dumps pressure.

speaker: COLONY PILOT
text: I'll hold the pressure lever. Go!

speaker: SHIP AI
text: Refining complete. There is enough for one full tank and one half tank.

speaker: COMMANDER
text: That gate brought me here. It can take us back.

speaker: COLONY PILOT
text: And if it doesn't?

speaker: COLONY PILOT
text: Even. Fair enough.

speaker: COLONY PILOT
text: You'd give me the full tank? ...Nobody on Planet X would believe an Earther did that.

speaker: COLONY PILOT
text: Of course. Earth first. I should have guessed.

speaker: COMMANDER
text: A carving of ships passing through rings. They built these to travel between worlds.

speaker: COMMANDER
text: The same three symbols repeat beside the picture of a gate. It's an address.

speaker: COMMANDER
text: This one shows a planet with pieces being lifted off it. That is... not travel.

speaker: COLONY PILOT
text: That's not Planet X.

speaker: COMMANDER
text: It's not Earth either.

speaker: SHIP AI
text: Good news: the gate works. Bad news: it is one of many. I am detecting dozens of linked gates.

speaker: COMMANDER
text: A network.

speaker: SHIP AI
text: Each gate needs an address set in these symbols. Set it wrong and we burn fuel going nowhere.

speaker: COLONY PILOT
text: You're learning their machine faster than I am.

speaker: SHIP AI
text: The address leads to a world with heavy machine activity. Something there is still working.

speaker: SHIP AI
text: That address goes nowhere. The tablets in the ruins may hold the right symbols.

speaker: COLONY PILOT
text: This was an ocean. Look at the old shoreline. It's a hundred meters above us.

speaker: SHIP AI
text: That tower is pumping what is left of the water through a gate. It is automated. Nobody is in charge.

speaker: SHIP AI
text: Sealed, and the security system is live. We need a way in that doesn't set it off.

speaker: SHIP AI
text: This is a target list. Worlds ranked by their resources and by how well they can defend themselves.

speaker: SHIP AI
text: Entry 41: Planet X. Rich in minerals. Defenses: minimal. Status: next.

speaker: COLONY PILOT
text: Next?

speaker: SHIP AI
text: Entry 42: Earth. Large population. Water remaining. Status: queued.

speaker: COMMANDER
text: The gate that grabbed my ship wasn't an accident. It was scouting.

speaker: SHIP AI
text: The machines are not broken. They are doing exactly what they were built to do.

speaker: SHIP AI
text: The records name the network's control centre. I have its full gate address.

speaker: SHIP AI
text: I have two of the three symbols for the network's control centre. More records might give us the third.

speaker: COLONY PILOT
text: If that list is real, my people have no time left.

speaker: COMMANDER
text: Then we go to the place that gives the orders.

speaker: SHIP AI
text: Power feed isolated. The door thinks it is closed. It is not.

speaker: COMMANDER
text: There. A service duct runs right past the lock. I can reach the release from inside.

speaker: COLONY PILOT
text: On three. One, two... there. Don't tell anyone I helped an Earther break and enter.

speaker: COLONY PILOT
text: Put my hands in that machine because you say so? No.

speaker: SHIP AI
text: There is a wrecked maintenance drone behind the station. It may still carry an access key.

speaker: SHIP AI
text: You don't have the training for that yet. Press Tab if you have stat points to spend.

speaker: COMMANDER
text: A recording. Their homeworld was running dry: water, metal, clean air.

speaker: SHIP AI
text: Instead of fixing it, they built machines to take from other worlds. This network.

speaker: COMMANDER
text: Evacuation orders. They knew their world was failing, so they built escape sites across the network.

speaker: SHIP AI
text: The logs simply stop. The evacuation failed. The machines never noticed their makers were gone.

speaker: SHIP AI
text: A star chart of the builders' homeworld. Blue oceans. One small burnt moon.

speaker: COLONY PILOT
text: That's where we met.

speaker: COMMANDER
text: It was never a second Earth. It was their home. It healed after they were gone.

speaker: SHIP AI
text: Old human transmissions, trapped in the network's distortion. Earth called Planet X for nine years. The gates swallowed every signal.

speaker: SHIP AI
text: There is one more file. Earth's council closed the search early. The reason given: 'we cannot afford a rescue.'

speaker: SHIP AI
text: The pilot is still at the door. They have not seen this.

speaker: COLONY PILOT
text: So they tried. And then they gave up on us.

speaker: COLONY PILOT
text: ...Thank you for not hiding the second part.

speaker: COLONY PILOT
text: They tried? All this time, we thought they just left.

speaker: SHIP AI
text: Understood. I will not mention it.

speaker: COLONY PILOT
text: One thing. That list says Earth is running dry. You told me it was a paradise.

speaker: SHIP AI
text: Wrong address. The records in this station may hold the missing symbol.

speaker: SHIP AI
text: Hull integrity forty percent. We're on the ground. Mostly in one piece.

speaker: COMMANDER
text: Mostly?

speaker: SHIP AI
text: Your suit has limited oxygen. I suggest finding out if this air is safe to breathe.

speaker: SHIP AI
text: Nitrogen seventy-eight percent. Oxygen twenty-one. Commander... it's the same air as Earth.

speaker: COMMANDER
text: That's not possible.

speaker: SHIP AI
text: And yet you may remove your helmet.

speaker: SHIP AI
text: That's enough to patch the hull. Now, about those structures in the trees.

speaker: COMMANDER
text: These aren't natural. Someone built these. A long time ago.

speaker: SHIP AI
text: The markings match nothing in my database. And the stars last night matched no chart of Earth's sky.

speaker: COMMANDER
text: A ring, big enough to fly a ship through. This is what pulled me in.

speaker: SHIP AI
text: It still has power. It is thousands of years old, and it still has power.

speaker: SHIP AI
text: Commander, I'm picking up a radio signal. It's human. An old frequency. Very old.

speaker: COMMANDER
text: Another rocket. Old. Patched together by hand.

speaker: SHIP AI
text: Commander. There is someone inside. Human.

speaker: COMMANDER
text: Hello? I'm not armed. My ship came down past the ridge.

speaker: COLONY PILOT
text: ...You're human. Where are you from?

speaker: COMMANDER
text: Earth.

speaker: COLONY PILOT
text: Earth. The world that left my great-grandparents behind.

speaker: SHIP AI
text: Three days of notes. They come from a colony on Planet X. They were sent to find Earth.

speaker: SHIP AI
text: Also, they found your footprints yesterday.

speaker: COLONY PILOT
text: You can come out. I know you've been watching me.

speaker: COLONY PILOT
text: ...At least you admit it. I'd have done the same.

speaker: COLONY PILOT
text: Sure you did.

speaker: COLONY PILOT
text: I'm from the colony on Planet X. A hundred years cut off. We're running out of everything.

speaker: COLONY PILOT
text: They sent me to find Earth and ask for help. Is it true Earth has oceans you can drink from?

speaker: COLONY PILOT
text: Then we're both a long way from help.

speaker: COLONY PILOT
text: It always is.

speaker: COLONY PILOT
text: A paradise. That's what the old stories say too.

speaker: SHIP AI
text: Neither ship has the fuel to leave. The burnt moon has ice we could refine.

speaker: COLONY PILOT
text: My ship can still fly that far. My pump, your refinery. Neither works alone.

speaker: ENGINEER
text: Commander.

speaker: ENGINEER
text: Commander?

speaker: ENGINEER
text: Commander! Wake up. It's launch day.

speaker: ENGINEER
text: There you are. She's fuelled and she's angry. Six hours to launch.

speaker: ENGINEER
text: Three things still aren't aboard: the water ration, the seed vault and the guidance core.

speaker: COMMANDER
text: The three things I can't fly without.

speaker: ENGINEER
text: Then stop standing here. Bring them to the cargo lift and I'll get them stowed.

speaker: ENGINEER
text: One more thing. Flight wants your training record signed off. Pick what you're best at.

speaker: QUARTERMASTER
text: That's the last of Reservoir Three. Forty litres.

speaker: QUARTERMASTER
text: Used to be you couldn't see the far shore of this lake.

speaker: COMMANDER
text: I learned to swim here.

speaker: QUARTERMASTER
text: Then bring some back with you, Commander.

speaker: COMMANDER
text: The guidance core. Every chart we have of a place no one has ever been.

speaker: COMMANDER
text: Fourteen months of flying on somebody's best guess.

speaker: COMMANDER
text: That shelf behind you. Is that a spare suit canister?

speaker: QUARTERMASTER
text: It's the last one, and it's on my inventory, not yours.

speaker: QUARTERMASTER
text: ...Take it. And don't make me regret the paperwork.

speaker: QUARTERMASTER
text: Nice try, Commander. The answer's no.

speaker: QUARTERMASTER
text: You don't outrank a locked cabinet. No.

speaker: QUARTERMASTER
text: Appreciate that. Fly safe.

speaker: ENGINEER
text: You're not going up until I've seen you use it. The practice range is just east of the pad.

speaker: ENGINEER
text: Five bays, left to right. Each one teaches you one thing. The lamp over the bay goes green when you've got it.

speaker: ENGINEER
text: The blue plates are frost glaze. Nothing grips frost. The ball skips off it like a stone off water.

speaker: ENGINEER
text: Grip, knock, bank. That's all it does, and it's all you'll need.

speaker: COMMANDER
text: Let's hope so.

speaker: BOTANIST
text: Commander. I was afraid you'd leave without it.

speaker: BOTANIST
text: Every crop we still have, in one case. Wheat, rice, beans. Forty thousand seeds.

speaker: BOTANIST
text: Nothing grows here anymore. Tell me honestly. Do you think Planet X has soil?

speaker: BOTANIST
text: The truth. That's all any of us can ask for now.

speaker: BOTANIST
text: I hope you're right. I need you to be right.

speaker: BOTANIST
text: Then don't come back until you do.

speaker: ENGINEER
text: That's everything on the manifest. And one thing that isn't.

speaker: COMMANDER
text: It's... a lumpy metal ball.

speaker: ENGINEER
text: It's a grip anchor. See the bumps? They bite into anything. Rock, hull, ice.

speaker: ENGINEER
text: If you're ever floating free with nothing to push against, throw it. It grips, the line goes tight, and you reel yourself in.

speaker: COMMANDER
text: You built this for me?

speaker: ENGINEER
text: I built it so you'd come back. Promise me you'll come back.

speaker: ENGINEER
text: I'm holding you to that.

speaker: ENGINEER
text: Try hard.

speaker: ENGINEER
text: As long as there's power to run them.

speaker: ENGINEER
text: This is it, then.

speaker: COMMANDER
text: This is it.

speaker: CONTROLLER
text: T minus ten. Nine. Eight. Seven.

speaker: CONTROLLER
text: Main engine start. Five. Four. Three. Two. One.

speaker: CONTROLLER
text: Liftoff. We have liftoff.

speaker: ENGINEER
text: Go on. Find us a way.

speaker: SHIP AI
text: Commander, we are out of fuel cells.

speaker: COLONY PILOT
text: Take two of mine. We get home together, or not at all.

speaker: SHIP AI
text: Commander! Oxygen critical. Commander, do you read?

speaker: FLIGHT DIRECTOR
text: All stations, this is Flight. Fourteen months out, and this is it. Final approach to Planet X.

speaker: CONTROLLER
text: Telemetry is green across the board, Flight.

speaker: TECHNICIAN
text: He's actually going to make it.

speaker: CONTROLLER
text: Fourteen months, one pilot, and not a single missed burn. Of course he is.

speaker: TECHNICIAN
text: My kids are watching this at school. The whole planet is.

speaker: FLIGHT DIRECTOR
text: Commander, you're forty thousand kilometers out. The whole world is watching you.

speaker: COMMANDER
text: Copy, Flight. Tell the world I can see it from here. We're going to make it.

speaker: CONTROLLER
text: Flight, I have a gravity spike. Dead ahead of the rocket.

speaker: TECHNICIAN
text: What is that?

speaker: CONTROLLER
text: It's not on any chart. It wasn't there a second ago.

speaker: FLIGHT DIRECTOR
text: Commander, abort the approach. Pull away. Pull away now!

speaker: COMMANDER
text: Flight, there's a ring out here. It's pulling me in. I can't break away—

speaker: COMMANDER
text: Flight? Flight, do you read—
